decision_profile.decision_thesis: Orris Greenbay Golf Homes is a high-conviction residential asset in Sector 22D, offering balanced price-to-quality ratios and strong livability metrics.
why_buy: Strategic location in Sector 22D, Yamuna Expressway with high capital appreciation potential.
Quality construction by Orris Infrastructure with comprehensive modern lifestyle amenities.
Strong connectivity to major expressways, commercial business hubs, and proposed infrastructure.
why_avoid: Social infrastructure (operational multi-specialty hospitals, international schools) is in early setup phase.
Public transit currently depends on personal vehicles or expressway bus routes pending airport rapid rail link.
decision_profile.best_for: Families, corporate professionals, and long-term capital appreciation investors.
decision_profile.not_ideal_for: Buyers seeking purely short-term speculative flipping under 12 months.
